continuation.admit.note: Codex never waits for the client at a continuation boundary.

continuation.observe.note: thread/tokenUsage/updated marks one boundary per model invocation.

continuation.steer.note: turn/steer is accepted mid-tool and consumed at the next boundary.

effort.rebind.note: turn/start accepts an effort override; no mid-turn rebinding exists.

execution.interrupt.note: turn/interrupt ends the active turn as interrupted.

model.rebind.note: turn/start accepts a model override; no mid-turn rebinding exists.

tool.observe.note: Item lifecycle exposes tool status, exit code and duration.
